name: Is a small water heater drip something I can ignore?

mainEntity.name: Is a small water heater drip something I can ignore?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small drip from your water heater should not be ignored, as it often indicates an underlying issue that could worsen over time. Even a minor drip can lead to significant water damage, mold growth, or indicate a more serious problem like internal tank corrosion or a failing component. Addressing a small leak promptly can prevent it from escalating into a costly emergency. It’s always best to have it inspected by a professional plumber to determine the cause and appropriate repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, a small drip should not be ignored. It can lead to water damage, mold, or indicate a more serious underlying problem. Get it inspected promptly.
